youtube.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb 🐑 Find the Lamb at School | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Sing Mary Had a Little Lamb with Robo, Mary and her little white lamb! The lamb follows Mary everywhere, all the way to school. At school it hides behind the slide, the books, the paint table and the lunch table: watch it peek out, count down 3, 2, 1 and find it. Say "Is it white? Yes!", count the lamb's hops and steps, ring the school bell and fill the school tracker, then a quick point-to-it quiz and one last verse with everyone.

Your child learns: following (the lamb follows Mary), school things (slide, book, paint, lunch), the colour white, and counting to four.

Sing at home: walk around the room and let your little one follow you like the lamb, hide a toy and say "Where is the lamb? Peekaboo!", and ask "Is it white?" about things you see. The first verses of Mary Had a Little Lamb (the lamb, everywhere that Mary went, it followed her to school, laugh and play) are traditional public-domain lyrics sung to the traditional public-domain tune; the school verses (the slide, the picture book, the paint table and lunch) are original.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.
